verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a broad Manage Vanta API. It covers listing documents, policies, evidence and tests; uploading documents; bulk-assigning owners and marking items out of scope; offboarding employees; assigning control owners; pushing custom resources and tests; and managing questionnaire responses. It also offers an Auditor API with SDKs, webhooks, and an MCP server that acts on compliance data. However, nothing claims UI parity, and many UI product areas have no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage for Trust Center, access reviews, risk management, TPRM and AI Agent workflows, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
